annotations.description: Gem3F Sarge is at 11 life and taking 4 damage from an unblocked Sazh's Chocobo (4/5), going to 7 life. The opponent is at 3 life and Gem3F Sarge has two Deep-Cavern Bats (1/1 flyers) that are tapped (presumably attacked this turn or were tapped). However, blocking with Enduring Curiosity (4/3) would trade it into the 4/5 Chocobo - Enduring Curiosity dies but returns as an enchantment (losing its 4/3 body but keeping the card-draw ability). Taking 4 damage when at 11 life against an opponent at 3 life seems acceptable on the surface, but the Chocobo will keep growing with landfall triggers and Earthbender Ascension has 7 quest counters meaning every land drop gives +1/+1 counters and trample. The Chocobo could quickly become lethal. Blocking with Enduring Curiosity to kill the Chocobo (trading a 4/3 body that comes back as an enchantment) would remove the primary threat while preserving the card-draw engine. The opponent's only creature would be gone, and Gem3F Sarge could close the game with flyers against an opponent at 3 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to block, taking 4 damage from Sazh's Chocobo (4/5), going from 11 to 7 life.
annotations.betterLine: Block Sazh's Chocobo with Enduring Curiosity. The Chocobo (4/5) kills Enduring Curiosity (4/3), but Enduring Curiosity returns as an enchantment keeping its card-draw ability. The Chocobo takes 4 damage and survives at 4/1... actually it would survive. But activating Soulstone Sanctuary for 4 mana to make it a 3/3 and double-blocking with both Enduring Curiosity and the Sanctuary creature would kill the 4/5 Chocobo while preserving life total. Alternatively, just blocking with Enduring Curiosity still deals 4 damage to the Chocobo, leaving it at 4/1, which is much less threatening.

annotations.description: Gem3F Sarge is at 11 life facing a Sazh's Chocobo attack that deals 4 damage (dropping to 7), but the opponent is at only 3 life. Enduring Curiosity is a 4/3 on the battlefield (it's an enchantment creature). The two Deep-Cavern Bats are tapped, but Enduring Curiosity should be untapped and able to attack. Looking at the board more carefully: Enduring Curiosity is untapped on Gem3F Sarge's side. The opponent is at 3 life. Even if Enduring Curiosity can't attack this combat (it's the defender's combat phase - wait, no, this is Turn 10 COMBAT for Gem3F Sarge, meaning it's Gem3F Sarge's combat phase). But the Chocobo is tapped on the opponent's side, suggesting the opponent already attacked. Re-reading: the 'After' says Sarge loses 4 life from Chocobo, so this must be during the opponent's attack. Actually, looking again - the decision says 'Turn 10 COMBAT - Gem3F Sarge' which means it's Sarge's turn. But the Chocobo is tapped and deals combat damage after... This is confusing. Let me reconsider: the Soulstone Sanctuary can be activated for 4 mana to become a 3/3 creature. Sarge has untapped lands: Gloomlake Verge, two Soulstone Sanctuaries. That's not enough mana for Restless Reef (needs 2UB) or Soulstone (needs 4). Wait - but the choices explicitly offer these activations. With Gloomlake Verge + 2 Soulstone Sanctuaries = 3 mana available, not enough for any activation. Actually Soulstone Sanctuary taps for colorless, so 3 total mana. Restless Reef needs 2UB (4 mana). Soulstone needs 4. None are castable. But Floodpits Drowner costs 1U - that's castable with Gloomlake Verge (U) + Soulstone (C) = 1U. And Floodpits Drowner enters and taps a creature with a stun counter. More importantly, it's a 2/1 flash creature that could block the Chocobo. If this is actually the opponent's combat and Sarge can flash in a Floodpits Drowner to block, that would save significant life. Actually re-reading: if Sarge loses 4 life from Chocobo AFTER passing, this must be during opponent's turn or there's a combat where Chocobo is attacking. Given the 'After' line, Sarge declined to act and took 4 damage. If a flash blocker could have been deployed to block or the Drowner's ETB could tap the Chocobo, that's a significant miss at 11 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to cast any spells or activate any abilities during combat, taking 4 damage from Sazh's Chocobo.
annotations.betterLine: Flash in Floodpits Drowner (costs 1U, payable with Gloomlake Verge + Soulstone Sanctuary) to either block the Chocobo or use its ETB to tap it and put a stun counter on it, preventing 4 combat damage. At 11 life with the opponent at 3, preserving life total while having a path to close out the game is critical.

annotations.description: Requiting Hex was cast targeting Llanowar Elves, but Llanowar Elves is in the graveyard, not on the battlefield. Since Sazh's Chocobo has mana value 1 (costs {G}), it's a legal target for Requiting Hex. Killing the Chocobo removes the opponent's biggest threat, while the Llanowar Elves appears to be a much less impactful creature (1/1). With the opponent at 3 life and Gem3F Sarge having flyers (two Deep-Cavern Bats + Enduring Curiosity), removing the Chocobo would both eliminate the biggest blocker threat and the opponent's primary damage source.
